# Sujay Aryal

> Software engineer based in Mumbai, India. Builds and operates production systems end to end —
> web, mobile and infrastructure. Available for remote contract work.
> Contact: aryalsujay@gmail.com · https://www.linkedin.com/in/sujayaryal/

## Summary

Sujay Aryal is a software engineer with six years of experience shipping and operating production
software. He is the sole architect of a hospital inventory and supply-chain ERP running live at Nova
Hospital in Dhangadhi, Nepal, covering purchase orders, real-time stock control, multi-level
requisition approvals, VAT reporting and the Nepali Bikram Sambat calendar. He owns its architecture,
deployment and ongoing maintenance.

At the Vipassana Research Institute in Mumbai he has worked across applications and infrastructure
since 2020, building a multi-tenant visitor feedback platform serving five organisational units, and
owning three React Native applications with more than 100,000 combined installs.

His MSc research at Liverpool John Moores University, awarded with Merit, addressed hallucination
reduction in Graph RAG retrieval through context-aware pruning, relation-guided expansion and
dual-stage denoising.

## Technologies

TypeScript, Next.js, React, React Native, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, MySQL,
Python, Tailwind CSS, React Query, PM2, Linux server administration, retrieval-augmented generation.

## Availability

Available for remote contract engagements. Works across IST, European and US hours.
